body:
Investigating founder's 'colab is stuck no idea whats going on' report. Found and fixed two real bugs: (1) --level was wired into _spawn_server/colab_train.py last commit but the argparse flag to receive it on rl_train_packet.py's own command line was never added -- any run setting BRAWLPIT_LEVEL would crash immediately, caught via direct repro before reaching a real run. (2) nothing checked whether a spawned bin/brawlpit_server subprocess died mid-run -- since UDP sendto() to a dead process doesn't error and MATCH_TIME_LIMIT_TICKS counts ticks not wall-clock, a dead server could make an episode take up to ~5 real hours to time out, indistinguishable from 'stuck'. New _check_role_server_alive raises loudly the instant this is noticed. Also confirmed via direct investigation that a real 2048-step PPO rollout takes ~85s at this env's ~24 steps/sec throughput -- expected SB3 behavior, not a hang. 2 new tests, 125/125 total pass. BRAWLPIT commit 9ac9458.

⚓ ☃
title: S432/S434: dead-server watchdog + --level argparse crash fix
